# hush_service_agent_client_secret (Resource)

A client secret for a service agent, for workloads that have no identity to sign in with. Hush generates it and returns it only when it is created, so it is kept in Terraform state. An agent can have two at a time, which is how to rotate: add a second resource, move the workload to its secret, then remove the first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A secret for a workload with no identity to sign in with. To rotate, add a
# second secret, move the workload to it, then remove this one.
resource "hush_service_agent_client_secret" "ci" {
  agent_id = hush_service_agent.summarizer.id
}

output "ci_secret" {
  value     = hush_service_agent_client_secret.ci.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) The service agent's id.

### Read-Only

- `hint` (String) The secret's last 4 characters, to tell secrets apart.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The secret, sent as the client secret with Basic auth (the agent's id as the client id). Known only for a secret created by this resource: an imported one is empty.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by "<agent id>/<secret id>". The secret itself can't be read back, so
# an imported one has no secret value in state.
terraform import hush_service_agent_client_secret.ci agt-usAbCdEfGhIjKlMnOp/7f3c2a1b9d8e4f60a5b4c3d2e1f0a9b8
```
